worksheets.title: CBT thought record — 7-step worksheet
worksheets.safety_scope: Educational self-reflection only; not diagnosis, treatment, or individualized clinical guidance.
worksheets.privacy_behavior: The static web worksheet has no submit action. Text entered into the browser fields is not sent to CBT Cards and is lost when the page is refreshed or closed unless the user prints or saves it independently.

fields.label: Situation
fields.prompt: What happened? Describe one specific situation using concrete details.

fields.label: Feelings at first
fields.prompt: What emotions did you notice at the time?

fields.label: Thoughts
fields.prompt: What thoughts or images went through your mind?

fields.label: Evidence that supports the thought
fields.prompt: What directly known information supports the interpretation?

fields.label: Evidence that does not support the thought
fields.prompt: What facts, context, or experience complicate or contradict the interpretation?

fields.label: Alternative view
fields.prompt: Considering both sides, is there a more realistic, neutral, or balanced way to describe the situation?

fields.label: Feelings now
fields.prompt: After reviewing the situation, what do you notice now? It is also okay if nothing changed.

worksheets.title: Worry time — 6-step worksheet
worksheets.safety_scope: General self-reflection only; persistent or overwhelming worry may warrant support from an appropriate qualified professional.
worksheets.privacy_behavior: The static web worksheet has no submit action. Text entered into the browser fields is not sent to CBT Cards and is lost when the page is refreshed or closed unless the user prints or saves it independently.

fields.label: Choose a review time
fields.prompt: Choose a short deliberate period for reviewing worries rather than repeatedly engaging with them throughout the day.

fields.label: Capture the worry
fields.prompt: Write each worry in a clear sentence so it can be reviewed later.

fields.label: What can be acted on?
fields.prompt: Is this a practical problem with an action available, a hypothetical concern, or are you unsure?

fields.label: Choose one next step
fields.prompt: For a practical problem, specify what you will do, when, where, and what support or information you need.

fields.label: Set down what cannot be solved now
fields.prompt: Record worries that do not have a useful action right now without trying to prove them impossible or unimportant.

fields.label: Review what happened
fields.prompt: What did you notice after postponing and reviewing the worries deliberately?

worksheets.title: Activity planning — 7-step worksheet
worksheets.safety_scope: General planning and self-reflection only; not individualized treatment guidance.
worksheets.privacy_behavior: The static web worksheet has no submit action. Text entered into the browser fields is not sent to CBT Cards and is lost when the page is refreshed or closed unless the user prints or saves it independently.

fields.label: Choose one activity
fields.prompt: Name one task or activity rather than an entire project or life area.

fields.label: Why does it matter?
fields.prompt: What responsibility, connection, enjoyment, learning, care, or unfinished business would this activity support?

fields.label: Make the first step smaller
fields.prompt: Choose the smallest visible action that would count as starting.

fields.label: Choose when and where
fields.prompt: Specify when you will try the first step and where you expect to be.

fields.label: Plan for one obstacle
fields.prompt: What is most likely to get in the way and what modest response could help?

fields.label: Review after trying it
fields.prompt: What happened and what did you notice about effort, mood, energy, stress, enjoyment, or willingness to continue?

fields.label: Choose the next step
fields.prompt: Based on what happened, decide whether to repeat, reduce, adjust, or choose the next small action.
